protocol.sameInputs: Reuse frozen Jev state, instructions, criteria, candidate order and data split. Add only a generic interface adapter developer message.
protocol.schema: answers.<questionId> contains type=choice, choice, probabilities for every candidate, confidence. Usage and latency are measured API metadata, not generated.
protocol.confidence: Luna probabilities/confidence are generated self-reports; not Jev internals or established comparable calibration. Same numeric thresholds are reported for compatibility only.

simulation.fixedEvidence: Replay all 43 unique Jev requests exactly, then score the same 90 scenarios using Jev-selected probes
simulation.adaptive: Use Luna probe choice, same frozen response table, and unchanged followupRequest. Additional requests only for new selected branches.
simulation.forcedRanking: Also report five-profile rank after excluding unknown, matching prior supplemental analysis

mae.split: Same test 151; dev 30 unchanged and not used for prompting/tuning

protocol.cache: One call per exact request within run; reuse identical results across scenarios
protocol.failurePolicy: Stop scheduling on first failure, await already in-flight calls, preserve raw results including invalid outputs; no retry, normalization, fabricated predictions or alternative model
protocol.pricingCaveat: Estimate from reported usage; does not add cache-write charges not separately exposed in usage
protocol.tuning: Adapter, schema and protocol frozen before the first inference. No task-specific prompt tuning on dev or test.
limitations: Synthetic profiles can be unidentifiable from observations
Cached cases are not independent repetitions
MaE source labels can overlap or be inconsistent
Historical Jev calls are reused rather than rerun concurrently
Luna identifier is an alias, not a dated immutable snapshot
Same JSON schema does not recreate Jev training or confidence semantics

workflow.description: Sum of two measured request latencies per logical scenario; replay cache is not treated as a zero-latency inference. Student response time excluded. Costs reuse observed token usage, not a new uncached billing estimate.
